_comment: Card names Scryfall cannot resolve, mapped to their English name. Keyed by the normalized cardKey() form (lowercase, accents and punctuation stripped). Most are Portuguese registrations typed without accents — Scryfall's name search is accent-sensitive, so 'Po ao Po' misses while 'Pó ao Pó' hits. A few are misspellings. Add a row when scripts/sync-cards.mjs reports an unresolved name, then re-run it.
